title: Signal Pairing
prompt:
**Problem.** Given n device ids, print the maximum value of
a[i] xor a[j] over all pairs i < j.

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 200000; 0 <= a[i] < 2^30.

The all-pairs scan is the classic near-miss.

tests.name: classic set
tests.hint: 5 xor 25 = 28; the trie walks the complement path bit by bit.

tests.name: two values
load: 200000 random 30-bit values
tests.hint: Trie insert + query is O(n log V); all-pairs is O(n^2).
